case.instruction: Add exactly: the new red rectangle. the new red rectangle's center is the midpoint of the centers of A and B. the new red rectangle and A are disjoint with at least two grid units of clearance. the new red rectangle and B are disjoint with at least two grid units of clearance.

geometry.readout: Add only the shapes requested by the current task. Existing objects are labeled with letters. Determine their positions and sizes from the image. Do not erase or alter existing objects. Canvas coordinates are integers 0 through 80 on each axis; x increases rightward, y downward. One coordinate unit is 8 pixels. One grid unit of alignment/contour error is allowed, size ratios allow 10% relative error. Separation and containment require at least two units of clearance. Colors: black, red, green, blue, orange, purple. Available tools: line, rectangle, circle. Actions: tool, color, move, down, up, undo, finish. Tool/color changes require the pen up. Down begins a shape at the current tip. Up commits it. Undo cancels an active stroke, otherwise removes the most recently completed new shape. Finish submits even if incomplete. Invalid actions waste one operation. All seven actions remain available. Line uses its two endpoints, rectangle uses opposite corners, circle uses center then a point on its radius. Moves while down replace a preview; only the final shape is committed. Select one action, then any requested parameter. To choose a move destination, use four successive 3x3 partitions numbered 1-9 in reading order. Each question narrows the highlighted region. The actual tip moves only after all four selections; searching leaves no ink.
